records.subject: Foreign Affiliates Statistics
records.groupTitle: Statistics Of Foreign Affiliates In Singapore
records.title: Statistics Of Foreign Affiliates In Singapore, Annual
records.footnote: 1. Statistics of foreign affiliates in Singapore are also known as inward foreign affiliates statistics (inward FATS).  2. Employment of enterprises refers to total employment excluding migrant domestic workers.  3. Value-added of enterprises refers to Gross Value Added (GVA) less ownership of dwellings.  4. Exports and Imports of Goods & Services refer to cross-border transactions of goods and services between the Singapore economy and the rest of the world.
